```{r}
#| include: false
root <- here::here()
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
SiteValue <- .requireOneTarget(
  .currentTarget("siteID.target"), "siteID.target", "UHS by return period caption"
)
ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
  UHSTable,
  "UHS.TR.qmd",
  target = Target,
  siteID = SiteValue,
  base = TRUE
)
Vs30.target <- 760
p.target <- "mean"
AUX <- UHSTable[ID %in% ID.target & Vs30 == Vs30.target]
if ("siteID" %in% names(AUX) && length(SiteValue)) {
  AUX <- AUX[siteID %in% SiteValue]
}
TR.target <- sort(unique(AUX[TR >= 100 & TR <= 10000, TR]))
if (!length(TR.target)) {
  stop("UHS.TR.qmd: no TR = 100-10,000 rock rows.", call. = FALSE)
}
rm(AUX)
Sa.log <- TRUE
fill.target <- FALSE
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("fig.UHS.TR")
CAP <- CAP |>
  sprintf(
    Vs30.target,
    prettyNum(min(TR.target), big.mark = ","),
    prettyNum(max(TR.target), big.mark = ","),
    SiteValue
  )
```

  "TR.target", "p.target", "Vs30.target", "Sa.log", "fill.target", "CAP",
  "SiteValue"
), ls()))
if (length(Target)) {
  ID.target <- Target
} else {
  rm(list = intersect("ID.target", ls()))
}
rm(Target)
